stealth_exercise: [Seated Core Vacuum] While sitting tall at your desk, exhale completely and pull your navel inward toward your spine as hard as possible. Hold invisibly for 15 seconds. Repeat 4 times. Release any accumulated tension in your jaw and temples while executing.
habit_tracker_focus: [Water Bottle At Arm's Reach] Keep a full 1-liter insulated water flask directly beside your mouse hand. Drink one sip every time you complete a task.

nutrition_tip: [Neuro-Electrolytes] Add potassium-rich coconut water or an avocado to your midday meal. Neurons communicate via sodium-potassium pumps crucial for rapid algorithmic problem solving. Eat a fiber-rich breakfast (oats, berries, chia) to maintain balanced neurotransmitter synthesis.
stealth_exercise: [Stealth Glute Contractions] Clench both glutes firmly while seated for 10 seconds, then release. Perform 10 reps. Re-activates gluteal muscles deactivated by prolonged sitting. Execute silently without making any noise in your library or office.
habit_tracker_focus: [20-20-20 Vision Defense] Every 20 minutes of screen time, gaze at an object at least 20 feet away for a full 20 seconds to relax ciliary eye muscles.

nutrition_tip: [Gut-Brain Axis] Eat a serving of fermented kefir, kimchi, or Greek yogurt. 90% of serotonin is synthesized in the enteric nervous system, stabilizing stress during exams or tight sprints. Finish heavy dinners at least 3 hours before sleep so your body focuses on cellular repair rather than digestion.
stealth_exercise: [Doorway Pectoral Opener] Whenever you walk through your room or office door, place forearms on the door frame and lean forward gently for 20 seconds to stretch tight chest muscles. Focus on deep nasal breathing throughout the movement.
habit_tracker_focus: [Box Breathing Reset] Before starting a high-stakes exam or complex debugging session, inhale 4s, hold 4s, exhale 4s, hold 4s for 4 cycles to down-regulate sympathetic cortisol.

nutrition_tip: [Anti-Inflammatory Mind] Drizzle extra virgin olive oil over your evening vegetables. Oleocanthal acts as a natural neuro-protective antioxidant against oxidative stress from long screen exposure. Prioritize whole seasonal foods over processed snacks.
stealth_exercise: [Micro-Marching Stealth Steps] While standing at your kettle, microwave, or waiting for code to push, march silently in place raising knees to hip height for 60 seconds. Keep your core lightly engaged throughout the motion.
habit_tracker_focus: [Standing Standup / Lecture] Stand up during all virtual daily standup meetings or online recorded lectures to keep postural muscles engaged.

nutrition_tip: [Memory Consolidation] Consume wild salmon, chia seeds, or sardines 2-3 times this week. DHA fatty acids maintain membrane fluidity in hippocampal synapses for better recall. Sip unsweetened green tea (sencha or matcha) rich in L-theanine for alert calm.
stealth_exercise: [Desk Pushaway & Scapular Squeeze] Place palms flat on desk edge, step back slightly, keep arms straight, and squeeze shoulder blades together tight for 5 seconds. Repeat 8 times to reverse slouching. Can be done under any standard study or office desk without drawing attention.
habit_tracker_focus: [Git Commit Posture Check] Anchor a trigger: Every time you run git commit, save a document, or finish a study chapter, roll your shoulders back and take one diaphragmatic breath.

nutrition_tip: [Sugar Spike Prevention] Eat fiber and protein before carbohydrates in your meals. This blunts the glucose spike curve by up to 40%, preventing post-lunch lethargy at your keyboard. Pair your dark greens with lemon juice to increase non-heme iron absorption.
stealth_exercise: [Under-Desk Quad Extension] Straighten one leg under your desk until fully locked parallel to the floor, flex your toe toward your shin for 10 seconds, switch legs. 6 reps each leg. Perform with your eyes closed for 5 seconds to calibrate proprioception.
habit_tracker_focus: [Daily Step Target 8,000] Take a 15-minute brisk walk immediately after lunch to clear glycogen and reset dopamine receptors.

nutrition_tip: [Deep Sleep Prep] Take 200-300mg of magnesium glycinate or eat pumpkin seeds 1 hour before bed to calm GABA receptors after intense late-night coding or studying. Avoid drinking liquids 30 minutes before sleep to prevent midnight awakenings.
stealth_exercise: [Silent Wall Sit While Compiling] Whenever running a build, test suite, or long file download, lean against the nearest wall in a 90-degree chair squat. Hold for 45 seconds. Maintain a tall neutral spine and relaxed facial muscles.
habit_tracker_focus: [Digital Sunset 60m] Turn off all blue-emitting backlit screens 60 minutes before bedtime; read a physical book or review paper notes instead.
